Package edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.workorder

Class WorkOrder

java.lang.Object
edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.workorder.WorkOrder
public class WorkOrder extends Object
Represents a repair request and manages its lifecycle using the State Pattern. Stores the request information, assigned technician, note, and current state.
Author:
Aanya Tomar

  • Constructor Details

    • WorkOrder

      public WorkOrder(String requester, String description)
      Constructs a Submitted work order with an automatically assigned id. The counter is incremented after assigning the id.
      Parameters:
      requester - person filing the request
      description - description of the problem
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if requester or description is null or empty

    • WorkOrder

      public WorkOrder(int id, String state, String requester, String description, String technician, String note)
      Constructs a work order from stored information. Updates the counter if needed to avoid assigning an existing id.
      Parameters:
      id - positive work order identifier
      state - name of the work order state
      requester - person filing the request
      description - description of the problem
      technician - assigned technician, required only for InProgress and Completed states
      note - associated note, required for Rejected and Completed states
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any information is invalid for the specified state
